verdict.rationale: The docs say you can "page through the catalog" of processes, with cursor-based pagination via `nextCursor`. `ultrametric init --dry-run` also previews the selected skill files before writing them, so some browsing before installing is supported. However, this is a thinly described first-party process catalog rather than a clearly documented skills registry or marketplace. Missing for 10: search or filtering of the catalog, a registry, leaderboard or marketplace-style listing with metadata, detailed docs on what catalog entries show, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
